output.summary: Ticket records show Arts is not deprioritised: category- and priority-matched Arts tickets are within 0.3 days of others, and on-site hardware delays match Education at the same campus (Tue/Thu technician coverage). SlotBook tickets, auto-routed to P4 by RR-17 with a 21-day median, account for 70% of the resolution gap. SlotBook explains 42% of Arts tickets, but non-SlotBook volume is still 1.6x average, so it does not fully explain the volume. The acknowledgement template hides best-effort status. Whether Arts leadership was told of RR-17 is undocumented, and the SSO link to the SlotBook rise is unproven. Fix the support status and the acknowledgement, and monitor; do not impose P4 on all Arts tickets, decommission SlotBook, or transfer budget yet.
